text: Citigroup Inc. is a listed company whose largest shareholders are the asset managers Vanguard and BlackRock. Its 2026 proxy statement lists them as the two owners of more than 5% of its common stock: The Vanguard Group, Inc. (8.7%) and BlackRock, Inc. (6.9%).

source.name: Citigroup Inc.: 2026 Proxy Statement (Schedule 14A), 'Owners of More than 5% of Citi's Common Stock' (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: BlackRock, Inc. (a) 50 Hudson Yards, New York, NY 10001 129,265,958 6.9% The Vanguard Group, Inc. (b) 100 Vanguard Blvd., Malvern, PA 19355 166,504,200 8.7%

additionalSources.name: Simply Wall St, via Yahoo Finance: Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) is largely controlled by institutional shareholders who own 74% of the company
additionalSources.quote: The Vanguard Group, Inc. is currently the company's largest shareholder with 8.9% of shares outstanding. With 8.7% and 4.4% of the shares outstanding respectively, BlackRock, Inc. and State Street Global Advisors, Inc. are the second and third largest shareholders.
